label: lem:brings-euler-characteristic
title: Euler characteristic of Bring's surface
html:
Lemma. Euler characteristic of Bring's surface

Bring's surface \Sigma_4 has topological Euler characteristic

  \chi_{\mathrm{eu}}(\Sigma_4) = 2 - 2g(\Sigma_4) = 2 - 8 = -6 .

Equivalently, in the Hodge decomposition of its Hochschild homology (HKR) one has \dim HH_0(\Sigma_4) = 2 and \dim HH_{\pm 1}(\Sigma_4) = 4, and -6 is the alternating sum \sum_n (-1)^n \dim HH_n(\Sigma_4).

This is an invariant of the base curve of the archimedean realisation, not of the substrate object A. The categorical trace \mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{id}_A) = \dim_q(A) is a different quantity (the three Euler characteristics); for A = \mathcal{O}_q(\mathrm{SU}(2)) its regularised value is 0 (Euler characteristic of the regular representation).
